continuationGovernor.stopReason: Application and Printful charge-safety code is green on verified candidate 3c20e8a46e9137abc4694e7cfd9741ef45ca1fe5 with CI run 32405563664 and Browser QA run 32405563688, including the live issuedonce.shop customer journey. A fresh Safepay launch audit found two owner-facing release issues. First, Safepay's March 25 2026 v2 hosted-checkout guide documents /order/payments/v3/, Bearer authorization, integer base units, tracker= checkout URLs, source=hosted and SHA-512 over the raw webhook body, while Safepay's still-current classic SDK family implements the v1 order/v1/init, beacon= checkout and SHA-512 over the serialized data object used by ISSUED ONCE. The v2 guide does not document enough amount/currency/state webhook detail to safely replace the existing fail-closed verifier without real sandbox evidence, so no payment-truth weakening or speculative protocol migration was made. Second, Safepay's March 26 2026 website checklist requires public truthful contact/business-location information, clear goods/pricing description, working terms and a customized returns/refund policy. PR 3 currently has no public contact, terms or returns routes and the homepage footer only links to the in-page privacy note and BEGIN. Implementing the bounded compliance surface requires explicit owner design approval and truthful business address/phone values; no fake foreign domicile may be used. Safepay sandbox credentials and endpoint registration also remain an external owner gate.
